ma.setTabBarItem(Object object)

Dynamically set the content of a tabBar item.

Parameter

Object object

Attribute Type Default Value Mandatory or Not Description
index Number Yes tabBar item, counted from the left. The start value is 0.
text String No Button text on the tab.
iconPath String No Image path. The maximum size of an icon is 40 KB. The recommended size is 81 px x 81 px.
selectedIconPath String No Image path of a selected item. The maximum size of an icon is 40 KB. The recommended size is 81 px x 81 px.
success Function No Callback function for a successful API call.
fail Function No Callback function for a failed API call.
complete Function No Callback function used when an API call is complete. (This callback function is used whether the API call succeeds or fails.)

Sample Code

ma.setTabBarItem({
  index: 0,
  text: 'text',
  iconPath: '/path/to/iconPath',
  selectedIconPath: '/path/to/selectedIconPath'
});
